title: From the bench to the shelf: IFRA presents risk-based safety at the 3 rd China Perfumer Congress
summary: IFRA presented the risk-based product safety framework behind the IFRA Standards to perfumers, researchers and brands at the 3 rd China Perfumer Congress in Guangzhou, China.

extraction.key_fact: IFRA가 중국 조향사 학술대회에서 위험 기반 제품 안전성 체계를 소개했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: IFRA presented the risk-based product safety framework behind the IFRA Standards to perfumers, researchers and brands at the 3 rd China Perfumer Congress in Guangzhou, China.
